technique_name: Analyze the theme of loyalty in the book "To Kill a Mockingbird."
description: The theme of loyalty is one of the most prominent motifs in Harper Lee's classic novel, To Kill a Mockingbird. Throughout the story, loyalty is demonstrated by the actions of Atticus Finch, the main character's father. Atticus is fiercely loyal to his family, to his friends, and to his moral beliefs.
